request.question: Revenue by state in August 2018 compared with July 2018

sql: SELECT c.customer_state, CASE WHEN f.order_purchase_date >= '2018-08-01' THEN 'current' ELSE 'previous' END AS period, SUM(f.payment_value) AS value FROM fact_payments f JOIN dim_customer c USING (customer_id) WHERE f.order_status = 'delivered' AND f.order_purchase_date BETWEEN '2018-07-01' AND '2018-08-31' GROUP BY 1, 2

validations.name: join_multiplicity
validations.detail: fact_payments has 100756 rows for 100756 delivered payments: the join did not duplicate rows.

validations.name: grain_matches_kpi
validations.detail: Revenue@2.0 expects grain 'payment'; fact_payments grain is 'payment'.

insights.text: São Paulo (SP) makes 45% of August revenue.
